mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult host through face, hair or costume anchors and one repeatable stage axis. Rotate at least four celebration modules. Each module may introduce only one original short word, one prop and one host action; the action must visibly transform the word into a matching physical state such as extinguished smoke, inflated volume, unfolded paper, scattered confetti or illumination. Repeat two identity or layout anchors while material scale grows from handheld to stage-wide. End by gathering the host, selected prop residue and one original greeting mark. The reusable mechanism is one-word-one-prop-one-action materialization, scale escalation and host-led lockup—not the source performer, pink hair, words, props, stage layouts, typography, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original host with at least three identity anchors and one stable stage axis.
invariants.purpose: Keeps a narrator through rapid modules.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing host identity makes disconnected cards.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one new original short word, one prop and one action per module.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several words or props in one beat create visual clutter.

invariants.rule: Make the host action physically transform the word into a matching material state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Static text beside performance remains decorative.

invariants.rule: Repeat at least two host or layout anchors while material scale grows.
End with host, selected material residue and one original greeting mark together.
invariants.purpose: Collects modules into a final identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A text-only card loses the performer and prior events.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source pink-haired performer, face, costume, microphone and cane
source words CHEER, HURRAY, SURPRISE, WISH, HAPPY, PARTY, SHINE, FUN and CONGRATS
source candles, balloons, party cannon, flowers and theater props
source typefaces, colors, layouts and exact action-to-word pairings
source MiniMax H3 thread prompt, music, timing and creator identity
